facts.fact: PANEOTECH says HydroMet AI, an LSTM and SWAT early warning system, is in production for UNDP Mauritania with the National Meteorological Office and Civil Security, producing graded WARNING or CRITICAL risk scores for floods, droughts, heatwaves and storms in the Senegal River Valley.
PANEOTECH reports a measured 12 percent precision gain over SWAT alone on rapid flood detection, LSTM RMSE under 0.15 and AUC above 0.9 on validation against ten years of observations.

systems.platform: AWS microservices, stacked LSTM with Isolation Forest and SWAT
systems.owner: UNDP Mauritania, operated with the National Meteorological Office
